changeSet.sql: ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[UserAssetPermissions] ( @ResourceID int, @AssetTypeID int ) RETURNS TABLE with Schemabinding AS RETURN ( select rel.PermissionsBitMask, rasset.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID from [dbo].[asset] a inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.AssetID = a.ID or (rasset.AssetID = 0 and rasset.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID)) inner join [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationrule] r on (r.id = rasset.RuleID) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] rel on (rel.ObjectID = r.ObjectID and rel.ResponsibilityTypeID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID and rel.ObjectType = r.[Object]) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.id = rresource.RuleID) where rresource.SecurityAsset = 'R' and rresource.SecurityAssetID = @ResourceID and a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID union select rel.PermissionsBitMask, rasset.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID from [dbo].[asset] a inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.AssetID = a.id or (rasset.AssetID = 0 and rasset.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID)) inner join [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationrule] r on (r.id = rasset.RuleID) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] rel on (rel.ObjectID = r.ObjectID and rel.ResponsibilityTypeID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID and rel.ObjectType = r.[Object]) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.id = rresource.RuleID) inner join dbo.[Group] G on G.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'G' inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID and a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID where RG.ResourceID = @resourceId union select rel.PermissionsBitMask, rasset.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID from [dbo].[asset] a inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.AssetID = a.ID or (rasset.AssetID = 0 and rasset.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID)) inner join [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationrule] r on (r.id = rasset.RuleID) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] rel on (rel.ObjectID = r.ObjectID and rel.ResponsibilityTypeID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID and rel.ObjectType = r.[Object]) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.id = rresource.RuleID) inner join dbo.[Organization] D on rresource.SecurityAsset = 'O' and D.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID inner join dbo.OrganizationResource RD on RD.OrganizationID = D.ID where RD.ResourceID = @ResourceID and a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID union select rr.PermissionsBitMask, oride.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join [dbo].ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR on (att.[object] = RR.[objectType] and att.objectid = RR.[Objectid] and RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = oride.SecurityAssetID and oride.SecurityAsset = 'R' where a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID and RES.ResourceID = @ResourceID union select rr.PermissionsBitMask, oride.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join [dbo].ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR on (att.[object] = RR.[objectType] and att.objectid = RR.[Objectid] and RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) inner join dbo.[Group] G on G.ID = oride.SecurityAssetID and oride.SecurityAsset = 'G' inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID and a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID where a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID and RG.ResourceID = @ResourceID )
changeSet.rollback:
